caveats: the 120 worlds are 15 cells x 8 scenes; the eight scenes of one cell share its goal count and rescue roster, so the pairs are not fully independent
one world has zero on-time tasks (slack_matched_rate), so messages_per_on_time is computed on 119/120 pairs there and the exclusion is printed
byte_ratio is the mean of per-world ratios, not the ratio of the group totals
16 t tests per family: a raw p of 0.05 is not evidence at that level; read the Holm column
no seed replication exists, so the CI covers world-to-world variation only
primary_test: wilcoxon signed-rank, Holm-adjusted within (scope, comparator family) (16 tests/family); Shapiro-Wilk rejects normality in all scopes so the t interval is descriptive
